subject: Medford Family Network
overview: Host John Petrella interviewed Marie Cassidy and Irina Shumway about the history, community services, and upcoming events of the Medford Family Network. The guests also highlighted a major funding challenge following the loss of a long-standing state grant.

items.title: Introduction
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced the show and welcomed Marie Cassidy and Irina Shumway from the Medford Family Network.

items.title: Guest Backgrounds and Origins of MFN
items.summary: Marie Cassidy and Irina Shumway shared their personal backgrounds and described how they first became involved with the Medford Family Network.

items.title: Overview of Programs and Services
items.summary: Irina Shumway and Marie Cassidy outlined MFN's free services for families with children from birth to age eight, including playgroups, parent education, home visits, and diaper drives.

items.title: Successes and Funding Challenges
items.summary: The guests discussed organizational milestones alongside the recent loss of a key grant that accounts for half of MFN's operating budget.

items.title: Community Partnerships and Ways to Support
items.summary: Marie Cassidy and Irina Shumway detailed options for community donations, volunteer work, and organizational partnerships to support MFN.

items.title: Upcoming Events and Closing
items.summary: The guests previewed 33rd-anniversary events, including a dance-a-thon and teddy bear picnic, before John Petrella concluded the episode.
